purpose: Single index of every load-bearing claim in the repository. A claim that is not here is not a claim; it is prose. This file exists because 378 markdown files died while 48 executable test files survived, and because five mutually exclusive definitions of CYNIC are currently readable with no marker of which one is the reference.
authority_note: This contract is subordinate to contracts/foundation.json. It indexes; it does not decide. A claim whose status is contradicted by observed runtime state is corrected here, never in the prose that states it.

status_vocabulary.principle: Stated and load-bearing. No implementation claim made.
status_vocabulary.implemented: Code exists. Behaviour not re-verified by a check in this repository.
status_vocabulary.demonstrated: Recomputed from the tree and exact.
status_vocabulary.partial: True on some surfaces, false on others. The boundary is named in the evidence.
status_vocabulary.uncalibrated: The mechanism exists; the constants do not. Honest state, and deliberately not filled with plausible numbers.
status_vocabulary.untested: A falsification protocol is written and has never been executed. This is a distinct state from 'partial' and it was previously invisible.
status_vocabulary.falsified: Refuted by calculation, red team, or measured result. A SUCCESS state: the claim is now false in a proved way.
status_vocabulary.superseded: Replaced by a named claim that is still live. The pointer is mandatory.
status_vocabulary.blocked: Cannot proceed, and the reason is recorded.
status_vocabulary.unknown: Not established. Never rendered as a claim.

rules: A claim without a CLM id is not a claim. It is prose and carries no authority.
falsifier is mandatory. A claim that cannot be refuted is a belief and is not admissible here.
load_bearing partitions doctrine from architecture. Everything else is operator sovereign space and may wait indefinitely without costing the system anything.
supersedes is mandatory and points at a live claim. Unmarked supersession is how v0.1 and v0.2 stayed readable alongside v1.
falsified is a success state, not a discard. 26 refuted hypotheses are worth more than 26 unrefuted ones.
One writer. Two writers turn this registry back into contradictory prose within six weeks.
Text no longer asserts. It points. A document asserting something this file does not say is a defect.

claims.statement: CYNIC is a low-layer sovereign Rust runtime for multi-agent systems. It bounds, connects, executes, observes, and proves. It is the operating system on which a NationKit may run; it is not the product.
claims.falsifier: A surface that mutates state without passing admission, or a projection that reaches back into bootstrap, refutes the 'bounds and admits' half.

claims.statement: CYNIC is a sovereign judgment framework for digital systems.
claims.note: Superseded framing. Describes an architecture whose organs, dogs and crystals are listed in foundation.json deleted_authorities.

claims.statement: CYNIC is a persistent, self-improving, sovereign multi-agent organism — an ecosystem of autonomous specialised organs.
claims.note: Superseded. 'Autonomous' and 'self-improving' contradict CONSTITUTION.md 3.1 no self-amplification and 3.2 no self-judgment.

claims.statement: CYNIC is a deterministic network state governed by a token, a nation and a citizen class hierarchy.
claims.note: Superseded. Contradicts 'the human is the constituent power' and adds a counterparty a single operator does not have.

claims.statement: No mutation without read-back proof. A command that succeeds without proof is not a convergence.
claims.falsifier: An audit that exits 0 while its own summary reports status other than converged.
claims.note: boundary_coverage classes runtime_proof_over_prose as by_design_unenforceable. The rule is universal; its own enforcement is deliberately not automated. That is a decision, not an oversight, and it leaves the centre of the system unenforced.

claims.statement: Higher layers may depend on lower layers, never the reverse, and every crate boundary is guarded by an executable test.
claims.falsifier: cargo metadata showing a cycle, or a crate with no boundary test.

claims.statement: Governance is two primitives and four rights: an inviolable claim (material, exit) and a derived authority (weight, obligation).
claims.falsifier: A constructed system where the largest material holder has no path over another's claim and exit stays free, yet which is incompatible with weight being derived from observed contribution.

claims.statement: Governance weight is a pure function of observed contribution. It is recomputed, never read from a field.
claims.falsifier: A working system with stored, self-assignable weight that does not fall to capture.

claims.statement: Contribution is proven by consumption by a third party, never by declaration.
claims.falsifier: A system where self-declared contribution is not gameable.
claims.note: This is why entry needs no KYC: identity enters through work, whose proof is the output.

claims.statement: No treasury may be the sole legal defense of a permissionless system.
claims.falsifier: A permissionless system with an open balance sheet that survives a class action without structural loss.

claims.statement: The canonical validation gate is `make check` from an admitted build runner.
claims.falsifier: A CI run executing make check.
claims.note: DEFECT. The CI workflow runs cargo check and cargo test only. The canonical gate is not executed anywhere. See CLM-0012.

claims.statement: cynic dev is the machine-readable projection of the framework and agent-exposure ledgers.
claims.falsifier: n/a — refuted.
claims.note: DEFECT. The verb dev is absent from cli_args.rs. Consequently contracts/release-gates.json gate architecture_boundary calls `cynic dev check --architecture-only` and is structurally impossible to satisfy, and 12 Makefile targets guarded by require_surface cannot run.

claims.statement: cynic commands --json is the machine-readable reference of the operator surface.
claims.falsifier: Every command named in the manifest is routable from the binary.
claims.note: DEFECT. 151 commands declared, 31 unreachable: 23 bootstrap, 9 lifecycle, 4 runtime deps aliases. The manifest_domains_match_clap_surface check is red and is not a canonical gate.

claims.statement: Every durable rule declares dimension, scale, layer, authority, enforcement, and exception path.
claims.falsifier: A rule in contracts/ missing any of the six fields.
claims.note: The six fields are required of rules; no rule in contracts/ is currently expressed in them. The schema and its population are both absent.

claims.statement: An organism exceeds the sum of its parts, and the excess is measurable.
claims.falsifier: The written protocol: dual cohort, 100 tasks, ECE / SCR / Brier. Never executed. No result section exists.
claims.note: This is the only pre-written falsification protocol in the repository and it is the cheapest experiment available. Until it runs, ODYSSEUM, the market and the E-Score rest on assertion.

claims.statement: Agents can predict the consequences of a build — duration, success or failure, effect on debt.
claims.falsifier: A build corpus where predicted duration and outcome diverge from observed beyond a stated tolerance.
claims.note: The document answers its own open question with 'these metrics are measurable' and does not measure them.

claims.statement: A market converges on truth and detects collusion.
claims.falsifier: n/a — refuted by the project's own simulation.
claims.note: All 7 questions are marked resolved. Q4 records authority-competence correlation 0.9026 but no significant error reduction over 200 proposals. Q5 records that intelligent collusion is hard to detect. Administrative status was substituted for epistemic status. The missing measured_result field is now mandatory in open-questions.

claims.statement: The E-Score is a meritocracy, weighted quadratically, with 0.618 as an epistemic threshold.
claims.falsifier: n/a — refuted three ways.
claims.note: Refuted as ploutocracy dressed as meritocracy (red team); the anti-whale modifier multiplies the stake ratio by 1,000,000 instead of reducing it (mathematics-geometry-audit:183-192); 0.618 is a structurally aesthetic choice not tied to any loss function (:221). Retain only the residue the ownership spec needs: attributing a contribution to an observed outcome.

claims.statement: Tokenomics, market and cosmology belong to a NationKit surface, not to CYNIC.
claims.falsifier: A CYNIC crate that must carry an economic instrument to satisfy a runtime invariant.
claims.note: This partition is what makes the substrate forkable. It follows from 'CYNIC is the OS, NationKit is the product' and it is the reason no treasury belongs in CYNIC.

claims.statement: A measurement governs at most one power.
claims.falsifier: A composite demonstrably serving two powers better than two separate measures.
claims.note: A single scalar mixing capital, contribution and tenure was asked three questions and answered none. The anti-whale refutation (mathematics-geometry-audit:183-192, ratio 100 -> 1 000 000) is a counterexample for a wrong composite, not evidence for a good one.

claims.statement: No power is governed by a measurement its beneficiary can influence directly.
claims.falsifier: A self-reported contribution signal that resists capture at community scale.
claims.note: The check that survives one remove out: GitHub Stars are not self-reported by the buyer, but the buyer manufactures a measurement others then use. Only whether THIS actor is consumed resists it. That is also why supply is not a denominator for merit.

claims.statement: Alignment is a solvency condition, not consensus and not a majority count.
claims.falsifier: A headcount-based alignment mechanism that outperforms a solvency condition on system survival.
claims.note: Every agent wants more compute and none wants to cap it. The majority preference is inflationary while survival requires deflationary. No actor may gain more by the system dying than by it living.

claims.statement: Attention is generated by being spent and destroyed by neglect; no rule derives from an assumed conservation of it.
claims.falsifier: An attention model with predictive gain from an explicit conservation assumption.
claims.note: The V x I framing also computes energy rather than power, since intensity is a flow and accumulated volume is a stock. The admissible model is contagion: propagation by contact, saturation, decay.

claims.statement: A physical analogy generates hypotheses and never justifies a constant.
claims.falsifier: A calibration constant that is both calibrated against a corpus and justified only by analogy.
claims.note: The 0.618 golden threshold was already refuted in this repository as structurally aesthetic choices. The same rule now applies to the electricity metaphor, which is newer and more seductive.

claims.statement: The public repository is a generated artifact with infra/** excluded and identities redacted.
claims.falsifier: n/a — refuted by observation.
claims.note: DEVIATION. The Forgejo push mirror relays the raw tree: infra/registry.json is readable on the public mirror with node topology, RFC1918 addresses and SSH targets (observed 2026-10-20). The publisher that should render the exclusion (cynic dev publish) is not implemented. Exposure is reconnaissance-grade only: RFC1918 addresses are not remotely routable. Accepted risk until the exclusion publisher exists; the genesis release notes must carry this deviation. Follow-up chantier: implement the infra/** exclusion render.

known_contradictions.statement: Five definitions of CYNIC were readable with no marker of which is the reference.
known_contradictions.resolution: CLM-0001 is the reference. CLM-0002..0004 are marked superseded. The three surviving phrasings at README.md:3, AGENTS.md:3 and framework.json are the same claim and are not indexed separately.

migration.note: The doctrines under docs/ are deliberately not indexed. They are outside runtime authority per docs/README.md and foundation.json deleted_authorities, so indexing them would grant them standing they do not have. They become claims only on promotion through specs/.
migration.gate: A document under specs/ may not declare itself normative unless every claim it rests on exists here, and unless it names at least one INV and one falsifier. Enforced by no_normative_spec_without_invariant_and_falsifier in crates/cynic-cli/tests/architecture_boundary.rs.
